name: events_by_canvas_order
sql:
CREATE INDEX events_by_canvas_order
    ON events(canvas_id, event_id)

name: nodes_by_change
sql: CREATE INDEX nodes_by_change ON nodes(canvas_id, change_seq)

name: space_save_results_by_age
sql:
CREATE INDEX space_save_results_by_age
        ON space_save_results(canvas_id, created_at)

name: spaces_by_parent
sql: CREATE INDEX spaces_by_parent ON spaces(workspace_id, parent_space_id)

name: spaces_single_world
sql:
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX spaces_single_world
    ON spaces(workspace_id)
    WHERE is_world = 1

name: changes
sql:
CREATE TABLE changes (
    canvas_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    thread_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    snapshot_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(snapshot_json)),
    PRIMARY KEY (canvas_id, thread_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (canvas_id) REFERENCES spaces(canvas_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  ) STRICT

name: delta_log
sql:
CREATE TABLE delta_log (
    canvas_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    version INTEGER NOT NULL,
    entry_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(entry_json)),
    PRIMARY KEY (canvas_id, version),
    FOREIGN KEY (canvas_id) REFERENCES spaces(canvas_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  ) STRICT

name: events
sql:
CREATE TABLE events (
    event_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    canvas_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    event_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(event_json)),
    FOREIGN KEY (canvas_id) REFERENCES spaces(canvas_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  ) STRICT

name: nodes
sql:
CREATE TABLE nodes (
    canvas_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    node_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    record_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(record_json)),
    revision TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(revision) > 0),
    label_collision_key TEXT NOT NULL, change_seq INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    PRIMARY KEY (canvas_id, node_id),
    UNIQUE (canvas_id, label_collision_key),
    FOREIGN KEY (canvas_id) REFERENCES spaces(canvas_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  ) STRICT

name: server_records
sql:
CREATE TABLE server_records (
        owner_key TEXT NOT NULL,
        name TEXT NOT NULL,
        record_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(record_json)),
        updated_at REAL NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY (owner_key, name)
      ) STRICT

name: space_extensions
sql:
CREATE TABLE space_extensions (
    extension_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    canvas_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    namespace TEXT NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE (canvas_id, namespace),
    FOREIGN KEY (canvas_id) REFERENCES spaces(canvas_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  ) STRICT

name: space_save_heads
sql:
CREATE TABLE space_save_heads (
        canvas_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        lineage TEXT NOT NULL,
        floor INTEGER NOT NULL,
        stamps_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(stamps_json)),
        FOREIGN KEY (canvas_id) REFERENCES spaces(canvas_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
      ) STRICT

name: space_save_results
sql:
CREATE TABLE space_save_results (
        canvas_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        principal_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        operation_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        digest TEXT NOT NULL,
        at_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
        created_at REAL NOT NULL,
        response_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(response_json)),
        PRIMARY KEY (canvas_id, principal_id, operation_id),
        FOREIGN KEY (canvas_id) REFERENCES spaces(canvas_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
      ) STRICT

name: spaces
sql:
CREATE TABLE spaces (
    canvas_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    title TEXT,
    collision_key TEXT NOT NULL,
    version INTEGER NOT NULL,
    state_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(state_json)),
    created_at REAL NOT NULL,
    updated_at REAL NOT NULL,
    is_world INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (is_world IN (0, 1)), parent_space_id TEXT, parent_entry_node_id TEXT, node_change_seq INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    UNIQUE (workspace_id, collision_key),
    FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id) REFERENCES workspaces(workspace_id)
      ON DELETE CASCADE
  ) STRICT

name: tasks
sql:
CREATE TABLE tasks (
    canvas_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    snapshot_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(snapshot_json)),
    FOREIGN KEY (canvas_id) REFERENCES spaces(canvas_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  ) STRICT

name: workspaces
sql:
CREATE TABLE workspaces (
    workspace_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at REAL NOT NULL,
    last_opened_at REAL NOT NULL,
    -- Membership is forgettable without being destructive: the port's
    -- remove() drops a Workspace from the listing and keeps everything it
    -- owns, the way forgetting a Disk Workspace leaves its folder on disk.
    forgotten_at REAL
  ) STRICT
